mediaWork.title: Exoneration Nation
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Texas exoneree Christopher Scott interviews fellow exonerees and innocence advocates about wrongful imprisonment and life after exoneration.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by Texas exoneree and House of Renewed Hope co-founder Christopher Scott (wrongfully convicted of capital murder in 1997, exonerated in 2009), sharing personal stories of fellow exonerees and wrongful conviction investigations.
